run_GetTestsForAllIterations: run the test program and return a list of tests for each iteration
run_GetTestCases: run GetTestCases to extract unique test case names from a list of full test names
run_CalculateTestLists: run CalculateTestLists to populate all test lists under different gtest flags
test_GTestShuffleUnitTest: test that gtest shuffle preserves test count and changes test order correctly
run_RandomSeedFlag: run RandomSeedFlag to generate a gtest random seed command line flag
